title: Temple Wars — Production and Defense Concepts
status: Selection concepts only; no gameplay changes. Codes B01-B12, U01-U12 and H01-H12 remain on the earlier sheets.

concepts.name: Bulwark Hall
concepts.does: Trains shield infantry and armor breakers. Unlocks a shield-wall stance.
concepts.weakness: Slow troops; weak against siege and flanking.
concepts.visual: A broad stone training hall, giant shield over entrance, shield racks and a bronze-banded practice gate.

concepts.name: Tusk Lodge
concepts.does: Trains boar cavalry and mounted war drummers.
concepts.weakness: Needs room to charge; vulnerable in narrow lanes.
concepts.visual: A timber lodge with a boar-head entrance, tusks, fenced boar pen, saddle racks and leather roof.

concepts.name: Rune Works
concepts.does: Trains rune gunners and anti-magic wardens.
concepts.weakness: Costly troops with slow attacks and long recovery.
concepts.visual: A compact bronze-and-stone armory with a glowing blue rune anvil, thick gun barrels, metal vents and crystal tools.

concepts.name: Mycelium House
concepts.does: Grows spore healers and mushroom sentinels.
concepts.weakness: Strong near a position; weak while moving and against fire.
concepts.visual: A squat mushroom nursery grown around a timber hut, giant green-purple caps, spore baskets and round wooden doors.

concepts.name: Tide Dock
concepts.does: Trains shell guards and brine slingers; troops cross shallow water.
concepts.weakness: Short range; vulnerable to long-range weapons.
concepts.visual: A land-placeable coastal barracks on a stone base, walrus-face beam, shell armor racks, rope winch and coral roof, no water scene.

concepts.name: Bell Sanctum
concepts.does: Trains grave cantors and reliquary guards.
concepts.weakness: Needs mana and a protected support line.
concepts.visual: A low gothic stone training sanctuary with one huge bronze bell, teal soul lanterns, small reliquary niches and a cloth awning.

concepts.name: Siege Yard
concepts.does: Builds covered rams and bolt carts.
concepts.weakness: Machines are slow and need infantry escorts.
concepts.visual: An open timber assembly yard, wheeled ram frame, long ballista limbs, pulley crane, stacked beams and reinforced shed.

concepts.name: Wind Aviary
concepts.does: Trains moth scouts and crane lancers.
concepts.weakness: Light flyers lose to dedicated anti-air.
concepts.visual: A tall timber aviary with moth cocoon frames, a broad crane-bird nest, landing poles, pale sail awnings and ladders.

concepts.name: Briar Lodge
concepts.does: Trains root trappers and armored thorn stags.
concepts.weakness: Traps need preparation; weak in open frontal fights.
concepts.visual: A low forest lodge with branching antler lintel, thorn fence, leaf roof, snare racks and amber sap lanterns.

concepts.name: Apothecary Yard
concepts.does: Trains pitch sappers and mist brewers.
concepts.weakness: Fragile troops; fire and mist need careful positioning.
concepts.visual: A stout plaster and timber laboratory with two brass vats, green glass pipes, pitch barrels and a work awning.

concepts.name: Wayfarer Inn
concepts.does: Hires badger guards and fox scouts for hero gold. A limited roster rests between hires.
concepts.weakness: Higher gold cost and limited stock.
concepts.visual: A welcoming crooked stone-and-timber roadside tavern, badger shield sign, fox-tail weather vane, travel packs and bench.

concepts.name: Cinder Inn
concepts.does: Hires coalback porters and salamander slingers.
concepts.weakness: Slow reserves and short-ranged fire attacks.
concepts.visual: A black basalt tavern with orange forge windows, kettle chimney, salamander sign, coal baskets and warm copper trim.

concepts.name: Pavise Guard
concepts.does: Blocks ranged fire from the front.
concepts.weakness: Slow to turn; flank or use siege.
concepts.visual: Broad badger humanoid, plated bronze armor, enormous rectangular shield planted before him, short side spear.

concepts.name: Chainbreaker
concepts.does: Cracks heavy armor with slow maul strikes.
concepts.weakness: Low attack speed; kite with light ranged units.
concepts.visual: Stocky human heavy infantry in leather apron and bronze armor, a huge two-handed hooked maul, broken chain belt.

concepts.name: Boar Lancer
concepts.does: Charges ranged troops and attacks the back line.
concepts.weakness: Pikes and roots stop the charge.
concepts.visual: Compact armored rider on a thick bristled war boar, long forward lance and small magenta saddle cloth.

concepts.name: Ram Drummer
concepts.does: A drum rhythm speeds nearby allied attacks.
concepts.weakness: Weak damage and exposed without escorts.
concepts.visual: Round red-panda drummer riding a broad-horned ram, a large side drum, two mallets and a banner harness.

concepts.name: Rune Gunner
concepts.does: Fires slow armor-piercing rune shots.
concepts.weakness: Weak against swarms and fast melee.
concepts.visual: Short stout dwarflike original artisan soldier, oversized single bronze rune gun, blue crystal chamber, leather hood and cartridge belt.

concepts.name: Null Warden
concepts.does: Raises a brief anti-magic screen for nearby allies.
concepts.weakness: Limited mana; ordinary physical attacks still hurt.
concepts.visual: Tall stag humanoid in plated blue-grey robes, twin bronze ring staff, small blue ward disk and antler helmet.

concepts.name: Spore Mender
concepts.does: Leaves short-lived healing patches for allies.
concepts.weakness: Patches are stationary; fragile when chased.
concepts.visual: Friendly toadfolk gardener under a mushroom-cap hood, spore basket, crooked sprayer staff and patched apron.

concepts.name: Cap Sentinel
concepts.does: A rooted guard releases slowing spores.
concepts.weakness: Cannot move while rooted; vulnerable to siege.
concepts.visual: Broad walking mushroom soldier with wooden root legs, thick layered cap like a shield and club-shaped arms.

concepts.name: Shell Guard
concepts.does: A durable amphibious front-line fighter.
concepts.weakness: Slow inland; vulnerable to armor breakers.
concepts.visual: Crab humanoid warrior in bronze shoulder armor, huge natural shell shield, short anchor-headed mace and barnacle trim.

concepts.name: Brine Slinger
concepts.does: Salt shots briefly reduce enemy healing.
concepts.weakness: Short range and little armor.
concepts.visual: Lean otter humanoid with rope sling, salt-crystal pouch, shell shoulder guard and blue leather vest.

concepts.name: Grave Cantor
concepts.does: A bell chant weakens enemy attacks in an area.
concepts.weakness: Silence or kill the fragile caster.
concepts.visual: Hooded spectral cantor carrying a handbell and an old hymn book, teal face glow, ragged dark cloth and bronze chains.

concepts.name: Reliquary Guard
concepts.does: Takes part of a nearby ally's damage.
concepts.weakness: Focus the guard or separate the pair.
concepts.visual: Heavy empty stone-and-bronze armor animated by teal light, large tower shield with a tiny shrine niche, heavy flanged mace.

concepts.name: Covered Ram
concepts.does: Breaks gates and buildings under an arrow-proof roof.
concepts.weakness: No anti-unit attack; vulnerable to fire and melee.
concepts.visual: Low wheeled battering ram under a curved layered timber roof, brass ram head, hanging hide curtains and magenta pennant.

concepts.name: Bolt Cart
concepts.does: A long bolt pierces a straight line of enemies.
concepts.weakness: Slow reload and a weak side profile.
concepts.visual: Compact four-wheel ballista cart with visibly stretched wooden bow limbs, one huge steel bolt and bronze winch.

concepts.name: Moth Scout
concepts.does: Fast air scout that reveals a small area.
concepts.weakness: Very fragile and deals little damage.
concepts.visual: Small hooded insectfolk scout riding a large pale green moth, broad translucent wings with visible veins, magenta saddle ribbons.

concepts.name: Crane Lancer
concepts.does: A diving flyer that can strike other air units.
concepts.weakness: Vulnerable during dive recovery.
concepts.visual: Light masked rider on a tall white crane bird with black wing tips, long lance and small bronze chest armor.

concepts.name: Root Trapper
concepts.does: Places a root snare that holds the first enemy.
concepts.weakness: Traps can be revealed; weak in direct combat.
concepts.visual: Small fox humanoid woodsman with antler snare frame, curved hook blade, green hood and thorn bundles.

concepts.name: Thorn Stag
concepts.does: Knocks back enemies after a straight charge.
concepts.weakness: Cannot turn during the charge; pikes punish it.
concepts.visual: Large stocky armored stag with bark shoulder plates, thick branching antlers, green leaf mane and a magenta flank cloth.

concepts.name: Pitch Sapper
concepts.does: Throws pitch charges against buildings and walls.
concepts.weakness: Must get close; very weak if caught.
concepts.visual: Goggle-wearing badger sapper with an oversized black pitch barrel backpack, smoking fuse tools and a bronze helmet.

concepts.name: Mist Brewer
concepts.does: Makes a mist cloud that reduces ranged accuracy.
concepts.weakness: Cloud also limits allied shots through it.
concepts.visual: Round toadfolk alchemist with two small brass mist tanks, long spray nozzle, leather goggles and glass potion belt.

concepts.name: Badger Mercenary
concepts.does: A tough hire that protects a hero.
concepts.weakness: High gold cost and slow movement.
concepts.visual: Scarred badger sellsword in patched heavy armor, large round shield, short notched sword, rolled bedroll and magenta scarf.

concepts.name: Fox Trailshot
concepts.does: A mobile hired skirmisher that marks targets.
concepts.weakness: Fragile; loses sustained fights.
concepts.visual: Slender fox humanoid scout with short recurved crossbow, long coat, feathered hat and compact travel pack.

concepts.name: Coalback Porter
concepts.does: A sturdy hire that repairs nearby allied constructs.
concepts.weakness: Slow; weak against magic and kiting.
concepts.visual: Short broad basalt-skinned construct with coal basket back, heavy bronze repair hammer, tongs and orange furnace eyes.

concepts.name: Salamander Slinger
concepts.does: Burning globes damage tightly packed ground troops.
concepts.weakness: Short range; weak against air and split armies.
concepts.visual: Small bipedal orange salamander with dark heatproof apron, bronze sling cup, clay fire pots and magenta neck wrap.

concepts.name: Timber Palisade
concepts.does: Blocks ground movement early.
concepts.weakness: Fire and siege break it quickly.
concepts.visual: A single modular stretch of thick sharpened timber stakes, horizontal braces and a tiny team pennant.

concepts.name: Stone Curtain
concepts.does: A durable wall segment with clear connection ends.
concepts.weakness: Needs space and loses to dedicated siege.
concepts.visual: One low broad stone curtain-wall segment, beveled capstones, bronze braces and simple crenellations, visible modular ends.

concepts.name: Bastion Corner
concepts.does: A reinforced corner connects two wall directions.
concepts.weakness: More expensive than a straight segment.
concepts.visual: L-shaped chunky stone corner with a round buttress, battlements and two clean modular wall connection ends.

concepts.name: Gatehouse
concepts.does: A wide gate opens for allies and closes against enemies.
concepts.weakness: The main breach target; needs repair support.
concepts.visual: A wide stone arch gate with thick timber double doors, two squat guard turrets and bronze hinge straps.

concepts.name: Iron Portcullis
concepts.does: A compact heavy gate holds a choke point.
concepts.weakness: Slow to raise; vulnerable while opening.
concepts.visual: A narrow square stone gate with a clearly visible iron drop grille, raised counterweight and chain winch.

concepts.name: Sally Gate
concepts.does: A narrow ally gate allows short counterattacks.
concepts.weakness: Low capacity; poor as the main entrance.
concepts.visual: A small side door set in a slanted stone wall section, bronze door shield, stair lip and one narrow guard window.

concepts.name: Arrow Gallery
concepts.does: A firing platform shelters ranged defenders.
concepts.weakness: Siege and flank attacks remain dangerous.
concepts.visual: A modular timber-roofed walkway on top of one stone wall segment, arrow slits and two empty firing positions.

concepts.name: Stake Line
concepts.does: Slows charges and hurts mounted ground attackers.
concepts.weakness: Infantry and siege can clear it.
concepts.visual: One low diagonal line of heavy sharpened stakes mounted in timber tripods, bronze spikes and red warning cloth.

concepts.name: Dry Ditch
concepts.does: A shallow ditch slows ground advances.
concepts.weakness: Flyers ignore it; builders can fill a breach.
concepts.visual: One compact rectangular dry ditch module with rough earth banks, timber retaining edges and a removable narrow plank.

concepts.name: Drawbridge
concepts.does: Opens or closes one narrow crossing.
concepts.weakness: Requires a suitable gap; exposed lifting chains.
concepts.visual: A short self-contained raised wooden drawbridge with stone abutments at both ends, two chain posts, no landscape.

concepts.name: Repair Post
concepts.does: Nearby workers repair defenses faster.
concepts.weakness: No attack; an exposed support target.
concepts.visual: A compact covered timber workbench with spare shield-shaped wall plates, stone blocks, lifting jack and repair tools.

concepts.name: Rally Bastion
concepts.does: A small shelter helps resting defenders recover outside combat.
concepts.weakness: No recovery during combat; siege can force it empty.
concepts.visual: A low open-front stone shelter behind a curved breastwork, lantern, field beds, bronze shield sign and team banner.

concepts.name: Repeater Tower
concepts.does: Fast bolts punish light ground and air units.
concepts.weakness: Weak against heavy armor and siege.
concepts.visual: A squat stone-and-timber watchtower crowned by a large twin-arm repeating crossbow, ammo rack and magenta pennant.

concepts.name: Bombard Tower
concepts.does: Slow shells damage clustered ground attackers.
concepts.weakness: Cannot hit air; dangerous minimum range.
concepts.visual: A low thick circular stone artillery bunker with a huge short bronze mortar barrel, smoke vent and shell racks.

concepts.name: Chain Spire
concepts.does: Lightning jumps across closely packed enemies.
concepts.weakness: Weak against single targets and spread formations.
concepts.visual: A narrow dark stone spire with three bronze conductor arms around a blue storm crystal and visible grounding chains.

concepts.name: Frost Obelisk
concepts.does: Ice pulses slow nearby ground enemies.
concepts.weakness: Low damage and a limited field.
concepts.visual: A squat engraved stone obelisk surrounding a chunky blue ice crystal, frosted bronze rings and snow only on the base.

concepts.name: Lantern Watch
concepts.does: Reveals hidden enemies and grants long sight.
concepts.weakness: Little direct damage; protect it behind walls.
concepts.visual: A timber watch platform with a huge golden rotating lantern, lens shutters, fox-tail flag and stone foundation.

concepts.name: Bell Ward
concepts.does: A charged bell pulse interrupts nearby spellcasting.
concepts.weakness: Long recovery between pulses; weak to physical siege.
concepts.visual: A low stone belfry with one enormous bronze bell suspended over a teal rune circle, chain crank and narrow roof.

concepts.name: Spore Bunker
concepts.does: Tough fungal cover sends spores at nearby attackers.
concepts.weakness: Fire and long-range siege counter it.
concepts.visual: A broad armored mushroom bunker with root buttresses, layered hard caps, small glowing spore vents and wooden hatch.

concepts.name: Root Snare Bed
concepts.does: Roots the first ground enemy crossing it.
concepts.weakness: Revealed by scouts; triggers on cheap troops.
concepts.visual: A compact square bed of curled thorn roots and leaf camouflage with one visible sprung wooden snare loop.

concepts.name: Pitch Basin
concepts.does: Sticky pitch slows a group entering its area.
concepts.weakness: No air effect; only protects a small patch.
concepts.visual: A shallow stone-edged dark pitch basin with broken planks, a tipped bronze bucket and low warning stakes.

concepts.name: Blast Charge
concepts.does: A buried charge bursts after an enemy steps close.
concepts.weakness: One use; can be revealed and cleared.
concepts.visual: A single half-buried bronze-and-clay charge, exposed gear trigger, short fuse and a small covering mound of earth.

concepts.name: Wind Totem
concepts.does: A gust pushes back low-flying attackers.
concepts.weakness: No effect on ground siege.
concepts.visual: A short carved timber totem with three broad bronze wind vanes, bird feathers, cyan wind ribbons and a stone base.

concepts.name: Shield Pylon
concepts.does: Briefly shields nearby defenses from ranged volleys.
concepts.weakness: A short duration; melee and siege pressure exhaust it.
concepts.visual: A squat bronze-and-stone pylon with an upright translucent blue shield disk, side capacitors and a magenta base banner.

concepts.name: Gate Pikeman
concepts.does: Braces a long pike near allied defenses to stop charges.
concepts.weakness: Weak while moving; ranged troops can kite it.
concepts.visual: Armored human gate defender, very long bronze-tipped pike, small back shield and fortified kettle helmet.

concepts.name: Banner Captain
concepts.does: A small nearby armor aura helps a tight infantry line.
concepts.weakness: Low solo damage; the enemy can focus the captain.
concepts.visual: Veteran stout human infantry captain with large vertical war banner, broad bronze shoulder armor, command sword and magenta sash.

concepts.name: Pavise Arbalist
concepts.does: Heavy crossbow shots from behind a portable shield.
concepts.weakness: Slow reload; weak against flankers.
concepts.visual: Badger humanoid crossbowman with a large pavise strapped to his back, crank crossbow and thick leather gloves.

concepts.name: Falcon Tracker
concepts.does: A trained falcon reveals hidden enemies ahead.
concepts.weakness: Weak sustained damage and low armor.
concepts.visual: Fox humanoid ranger with a small bow, trained falcon perched on a glove, hooded green cloak and magenta quiver cloth.

concepts.name: Lantern Novice
concepts.does: Places a small stationary healing lantern for allies.
concepts.weakness: The lantern can be destroyed; fragile caster.
concepts.visual: Young red-panda monk with a small amber lantern staff, simple jade robe, prayer beads and magenta waist sash.

concepts.name: Veil Sister
concepts.does: Cleanses one harmful spell and grants a short magic barrier.
concepts.weakness: Limited mana and little attack damage.
concepts.visual: Masked human priestess in white and dark teal robes, bronze veil frame, crescent hand shield and magenta sleeve trim.

concepts.name: Mortar Cart
concepts.does: Arcing shells punish units hiding behind walls.
concepts.weakness: Cannot hit air; poor at close range.
concepts.visual: Small reinforced two-wheel cart carrying a squat bronze mortar tube, bundled stone shells, rear stabilizer and magenta flag.

concepts.name: Field Engineer
concepts.does: Repairs machines and builds a small temporary barricade.
concepts.weakness: Almost no attack; needs protection.
concepts.visual: Badger humanoid engineer with bronze goggles, oversized wrench, timber plank backpack, tool apron and magenta cap.

concepts.name: Owl Rider
concepts.does: Night scout with a wide detection sweep.
concepts.weakness: Light armor and low combat damage.
concepts.visual: Small hooded ranger riding a broad-winged grey owl, huge readable owl eyes, bronze saddle fittings and magenta wing ribbons.

concepts.name: Kite Bomber
concepts.does: Drops a short line of bombs on ground targets.
concepts.weakness: Weak against air units and during the turn back.
concepts.visual: Compact masked pilot in an original wooden bat-wing kite glider with two visible clay bombs, bronze braces and magenta sail panels.

concepts.name: Bulwark Golem
concepts.does: A stone shield construct covers nearby ranged troops.
concepts.weakness: Slow and weak against melee armor breakers.
concepts.visual: Broad stone-and-bronze golem, huge rectangular forearm shield, small amber furnace core and magenta shoulder plates.

concepts.name: Siege Golem
concepts.does: A slow two-handed hammer breaks buildings and gates.
concepts.weakness: Low mobility; weak against fast ranged armies.
concepts.visual: Heavy stone construct with thick bronze bands, massive two-handed demolition hammer, glowing amber vents and magenta back pennant.
